chapter: Trio years, the Sands and Armstrong recollections
title: Timeline: Catskills, Riviera, Sands and the Atlantic Beach
summary: Windsor, Grossinger's, Riviera, Sands, and Atlantic Beach.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: That's what the idea was, because we were drawing too many people. I stayed in there from '55 to '60 and I was up at the--in '57 I went to the Windsor, up in the Catskills. I'd go up there for the summer and come back in the fall. I stayed at the Windsor for two years, '57 and '58 and '59 I went to Grossinger's. Then I came back to the Frolic. In fact, I did the Frolic until '60. Then in '60 I went to the Riviera, Rube Congris' Riviera, that was a wonderful, beautiful thing there. We really made a very rich man out of that fellow. In '62 I went into the Sands for two weeks and stayed the season, and the next season I asked for more money and I couldn't get it, so I went into the Atlantic Beach Hotel and
they gave me a contract for the next four years back at the Sands.

At the money I wanted. They had so many other places, there was this place advertised the Roosevelt Motel, we played there in the winter. In '64 I did the World's Fair. I stayed there until time to go back to the Sands in April.
